request.deadline: 12 months after closure of the existing contract
deliverables: Essential Pallas codebase maintenance, including dependency updates, Cardano protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, and documentation
Community support, including issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-feedback-driven enhancements, and public communication
AI-friendly documentation and integration resources for AI-driven development workflows
Milestone-based disbursement controls through Intersect treasury management smart contracts
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Fund Pallas by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Core Rust Libraries, Year 2, including part-time maintenance over 12 months and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.

Pallas is described as a collection of Rust crates implementing core Ouroboros and Cardano primitives including CBOR encoding, cryptographic operations, mini-protocol networking, multi-era ledger traversal, transaction building, and address handling.
The proposal states that Pallas is used by projects including Aiken, Dolos, Lucid, Oura, Mithril, Amaru, UTxO-RPC, and others.
The proposal reports Pallas has over 649 pull requests, 199 stars, 91 forks, 60 contributors, and 214,446 crates.io downloads, with links to the GitHub repository and crates.io package.
The proposed work package covers maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources to keep Pallas usable, reliable, and current for downstream projects.
The proposal claims alignment with Intersect Pillar 2 focus area A.3 for developer experience and open-source incentives for maintaining core Cardano SDKs, frameworks, and infrastructure.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and links to voting and audit documentation.
The proposal states the requested withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.

The proposal states Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, external oversight entities, and threshold authorization rules for fund actions.

The proposal states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals, with 26 delivered and 4 under development on schedule, and that prior Intersect maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC is being delivered on schedule.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month continuation of Pallas maintenance by TxPipe, routed through Intersect treasury smart contracts with stated oversight, milestone controls, prior process approval, NCL compliance, and a mix of asserted and externally checkable adoption and governance evidence.
